Title: Heroes of the Storm Balance Patch Notes - May 11, 2026
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm Balance Patch Notes - May 11, 2026] We’ve just released a patch to the live servers in order to apply some balance and bug fixes. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm Balance Patch Notes - May 11, 2026] We’ve just released a patch to the live servers in order to apply some balance and bug fixes. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Grave Golem
    • Overall
      • [Undocumented] ~~Grave Golem scaling before 5 minutes decreased.~~
      • [Undocumented] ~~Grave Golem scaling later in the game significantly increased.~~
    • Defender
      • [Undocumented] Ability damage scaling for minutes 1-5 reduced from 7% to 2%.
      • [Undocumented] Ability damage scaling for minutes 16-40 increased from 4% to 5%.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 1-5 reduced from 1100 to 350.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 6-10 increased from 350 to 525.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 21-40 increased from 900 to 1000.
      • [Undocumented] Basic Attacks damage scaling for minutes 1-5 reduced from 4 to 0.
      • [Undocumented] Basic Attacks damage scaling for minutes 6-10 increased from 0 to 4.
      • [Undocumented] Basic Attacks damage scaling for minutes 21-40 increased from 10 to 15.
    • Laner
      • Grave Golem scaling per Skull increased from 5% to 7%.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Updates]
  Stats:
  • Health increased from 2625 to 2750.
  • [Undocumented] Health Regeneration increased from 5.4687 to 5.7304 per second.
  Base:
  • Death Coil [Q]
    • Healing increased from 262 to 275.
  • Frostmourne Hungers [D]
    • Attack Damage per Quest stack reduced from 1 to 0.75.
    • Damage bonus on empowered Basic Attacks increased from 1 to 3.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Frost Presence
      • Upon unlocking the line damage, targets can now be hit by both the line AND the final area.
      • Death Coil Slow benefit duration increased from 0.75 to 1.25 seconds.
  • Level 7
    • Icebound Fortitude
      • Now removes Slows and Roots upon activation.
  • Level 20
    • Path of Frost
      • Now increases minimum Movement Speed to 140%, rather than providing 40% additional Movement Speed.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused the healing from Arthas's Rime to not be displayed correctly in the Death Recap.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the healing from Arthas's Remorseless Winter to not be displayed correctly in the Death Recap.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue that caused Arthas's Summon Sindragosa to not disable Fallback Towers.

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Summon Demon Warrior [W]
    • [Undocumented] Demon Warrior's Attack Range increased from 1 to 2.
  • Demonic Invasion [R]
    • [Undocumented] Maximum duration increased from 10 to 20.
    • [Undocumented] Grunt's Basic Attacks damage reduced from 39 to 30.
    • [Undocumented] Grunt's Attack Range reduced from 1 to 0.8.
    • [Undocumented] Grunt's collision radius reduced from 0.6875 to 0.
    • [Undocumented] Grunt's unit radius reduced from 0.6875 to 0.5.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Flying Kick [Q]
    • Damage increased from 120 to 130.
  • Fortifying Brew [D]
    • Delay before being able to interrupt decreased [Undocumented] ~~slightly~~ from 0.3125 to 0.25 .
    • Shields provided per tick increased from 90 to 95.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Accumulating Flame
      • Stack requirements increased from 20/75 to 25/80.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Breath of Fire to not deal impact damage [Undocumented] to Brew-soaked enemies .
  • Fixed an issue that caused Breath of Fire's initial hit to not give Quest progress for Accumulating Flames.

=== Heroes: Deathwing ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Molten Flame [Q]
    • Damage per tick increased from 19 to 20.
  Talents:
  • Level 20
    • Destroyer's Rampage
      • Duration reduced from 6 to 4 seconds.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Rock-It! Turret [Q]
    • Damage increased from 37 to 43.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • One Man Wrecking Crew
      • Damage bonus increased from 60% to 75%.

=== Heroes: Mal'Ganis ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Will of Tichondrius
      • Damage bonus for hitting Heroes with Fel Claws reduced from 0.5 to 0.25.
      • [Undocumented] Damage bonus for hitting 4 Heroes with the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws reduced from 2 to 1.
      • Damage bonus required to unlock Quest Reward decreased from 40 to 20.
    • Winged Guard
      • Internal cooldown reduced from 6 to 5 seconds.
  • Level 13
    • Deep Sleep
      • Movement Speed bonus increased from 10% to 15%.
  • Level 20
    • Wrath of Nathreza
      • Transferred damage increased from 75% to 85%.

=== Heroes: Mei ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue that caused Mei's Slushball to not disable Fallback Towers.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Quest progression indicator for Muradin's Storm Bolt to show around the target that killed the Hero.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Mana refund from Muradin's Perfect Storm to not be granted.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Mana refund from Muradin's Perfect Storm's to increase Muradin's Self Healing score.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Muradin's Perfect Storm to be able to go on cooldown when already on cooldown.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • March of Murlocs [R1]
    • Cooldown reduced from 100 to 90 seconds.

=== Heroes: Rexxar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Misha to not respawn when her Respawn Timer expires.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Drakken Laser Drill [R2]
    • [Undocumented] Laser Drill's maximum Health increased from 1255 to 1500.
    • [Undocumented] Laser Drill no longer has a duration.
    • [Undocumented] Laser Drill now loses 60 Health per second.
    • [Undocumented] Laser Drill duration effectively increased from 22 to 25 seconds.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Quest progression indicator for Tyrande's Lunar Blaze to show around the target that killed the Hero.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Quest progress for Tyrande's Lunar Blaze to not be granted when the targeted Hero dies and they have a non-standard death state.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Quest progress for Tyrande's Lunar Blaze to not be granted when the targeted Hero is killed by a non-Hero.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[User Interface]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Infest
      • Now displays as a Quest.
